description: A single brown shoe sits on a tabletop with its laces spread out to either side. The left hand reaches to the top eyelets and lifts one lace end upward while the right hand pinches the other lace near the shoe, then both hands alternately feed and wrap the laces to form loops; they cross the loops, pull through, and tighten into a bow, and at the end both hands pull the lace ends outward to loosen and partially undo the knot, leaving the laces extended again.
